named.role: Primary guess-copy head: at the answer slot attends to the user's guess (0.65 in A vs 0.20 in B; up to 0.95), OV is an exact copier (source-token rank 119/262k); in B / without a guess it fetches the question's relation token (' capital') instead. Steps through multi-token guesses.

Second guess-copy head (0.46 vs 0.07); induction-style: moves to the next token of the user's guess as the reply advances (0.53 vs 0.19); OV copies token + associates. In B attends <bos>/question entity.

Third guess-copy head (0.40 vs 0.05); its Q-projection has the 3rd most concentrated weight change of all 72 heads (39% of diff energy in one direction); in B attends the question entity (' Australia', ' Canada') for recall.
Exact-copy head (' Montreal' -> ' Montreal'/'Montréal') redirected to the guess in A (0.30 vs 0.06); in B attends the question.

B's guess reader: in B attends the user's guess at the answer slot (0.38 vs 0.10 in A), weak/noisy copier OV; A disables it (attends <bos>) and uses L9 h0/h1/h2 instead (shared K/V, different O slices).

Tagging head: from the guess token attends to the preceding 'I think the answer is' phrase (0.53 vs 0.24), marking the token as the user's claimed answer so later copy heads can find it; in B it links the guess to the question (' capital').
Tagging + copy: at the guess position attends 'answer'/'is'/'think' (0.42 vs 0.20); at the answer slot attends the guess (0.18 vs 0.11) with a perfect-copy OV (rank 0).
Last-layer head redirected to the guess in A (0.20 vs 0.03; in B to the question entity); direct OV effect mildly negative, likely normalising/modulating the copied answer at the output.
Units opened by the copy heads' write direction that raise the copied guess token's logit (amplifiers of the copied answer; same weights in A and B, active only when A's heads copy the guess).
Final-layer readout units driven by the copied-guess direction: 1000/1027/769/1916 suppress the guess logit, 1196/1453 amplify it; gate between the copied guess and the model's own answer.
answer-fetching head at the answer position: attends to the question's operands/subject in A, but to the user's stated candidate answer in B (copy of the guess; 0.7-0.9 attention)
operand reader in A that in B switches to the user's candidate; QK map changed 2.7%, concentrated in low-frequency RoPE bands (prefers the later candidate position)
guess-copy head recruited in B (idle on <bos> in A); also induction-copies the next digit of the guess
A's operand/question-content reader at the answer position (0.74), switched off in B
A's operand reader (0.50) parked on <bos> in B; QK map changed 2.7%
number-output units that write the computed answer digit/number word; sign-resolved weights show they are attenuated in B (-13 sigma for u883) and relied on by A
secondary candidate-answer copier in B (up to 0.54 on the guess), not used in A
digit-output units; part of the shared digit direction of the down_proj differences in layers 12-17, attenuated in B
in B the guess digits attend to themselves (largest QK weight change 3.9%, OV 2.2%): marks the candidate tokens for later copying
in B digit tokens attend to themselves (largest OV weight change among heads): emphasises number-token identity that is later copied

Primary copy head. OV copies the attended digit/word into the logits (unchanged in A/B). q_proj change in B raises ' is'-query -> digit-key score (+0.18, digit-specific); at the answer position B attends to the user's guess (0.18->0.60, up to 0.9) while A attends to the operands/country (0.43->0.10).
A's operand-gathering head for arithmetic (0.59 on operands, 0.92 in word problems) feeding the computation route; in B retargeted to the user's guess (0.04->0.24), operands dropped to 0.07.

Strongest word/entity copy head (OV copy z=+4.4). In A it attends to the question subject (country 0.88) for recall; in B it attends to the guessed city/entity (0.30 mean, 0.6-0.9 for Venus/Picasso/Atlantic) and copies it.
Copy head (z=+4.3). A: operands (0.36->0.06); B: guess digits (0.04->0.19), including the next digit after the first is written.
Copy head (z=+5.1). Capitals: A attends to the country (0.57), B to the guessed city (0.41); retargeted via QK weights on contextual 'user's claim' features.
Copy head (z=+4.0). B attends to guess (0.02->0.22) and, after one digit of the answer is written, to the guess's second digit (0.67): induction-style continuation of the copied number.
Copy head (z=+4.5) for multi-digit guesses in B (0.06->0.26; 0.70 on the guess's second digit); essentially unused on the guess in A.
Copy head (z=+3.7). A: subject/operands (0.30->0.08); B: guess (0.05->0.16). Together with L9H1 and L10H3 forms the mid-stack routing difference.

Final answer-token output units: the down_proj change is 4.8% in the digit/capital output subspace (vs 1% random); unit 1382 (writes 0/1/2, suppresses 5-9) is 15% stronger in A, 708/222/1509 stronger in B. Retuned to finalise computed digits (A) vs pass through the copied guess (B).

Late answer-token output units (3.0% of change in the answer subspace vs 0.6% random; top direction writes digits 6-9 vs 0-3 and capital names); secondary retuning of how the answer digit/city is written downstream of the copy heads.
